name: Hercules Silver Corp.
summary: Bald Eagle Gold Corp., a junior mining enterprise, is dedicated to acquiring, exploring, and developing resource properties across the United States. Its exploration initiatives primarily target deposits of silver, lead, zinc, and manganese. The company's key asset is the Hercules Silver property, situated in Washington County, Idaho. Notably, the firm changed its name to Bald Eagle Gold Corp. in March 2021, having previously been known as Wolf Acquisition Corp. This Canadian-headquartered company operates from Toronto.
